profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have around 6 years of work experience in the IT field which involves programming in the J2EE environment. I graduated from Wright State University in March 2012 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science. Over the years I have acquired skills in many programming languages which include: Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery. I also have experience with J2EE technologies such as JSP/Servlets, Struts1.3, Hibernate 3.6, Spring 5.x and Web-Services on IDEs like NetBeans, & Eclipse.  

	I am a conscientious person who is devoted and invested to my work and careful about details and care about the quality of the work I perform. I am a team player and incorporate others feedback into my work as others’ opinions are often helpful and valued. I am a pretty good problem solver when it comes to tough situations and difficult code. I work great under pressure and make it a point to prioritize my tasks.

projects.title: Customer Complaints Portal
projects.description: This application is developed for a digital retail outlet where they want to register complaints for the items sold and the system will consolidate all the complaints or customer issues to the respective supplier of them. This portal also being used as a warranty tracker and management system for the customer to extend and/or register their warranty claims.

projects.title: Material Request System
projects.description: This system is used to raise the requirements from different departments of an organization and the request details will be available for the purchase team to consolidate and categorize based on the urgency of need. Based on the costing of the material requested, there will be an automatic approval workflow that will be triggered to get the necessary approvals from respective department heads and the approved requests will be directed for finance approval. All the approvals and process are driven through SLA. Any deviations will be escalated to the respective division head for their action.

testScores.name: Design and Implement Catalog Table System
testScores.description: Design graphical user interface to display Table. Connect to a MySQL database create tables, add records, retrieve data from database within JAVA code, display data in table. Used JAVA programming language with swing and util libraries.

testScores.name: Design and Implement Simulation of muli lane car service center
testScores.description: Programming Language Used was C++. Output log of simulation to file. Simulated clock with timed events and multiple event types. Use many queues for each lane and events.
